description: No pull request is opened until its checkbox is ticked in the dependency dashboard (dependencyDashboardApproval), because merging to main publishes manifests that flux applies to the cluster. Commits read 'bump <name> to <version>', rather than using semantic commits.

Detection: jsonnetfile.json (with its lock file) is handled by the jsonnet-bundler manager. TypeScript has no built-in manager, so what an app.ts declares is found by shape (see tools/checks/renovate.test.ts, which fails if something is written in a way these rules can't see): container images (`image: "repo/name:tag"`, or `h.helmImage("repo/name:tag")` in a chart's values), helm charts (`ns.helm("<repository url>/<chart>?version=<version>")`), upstream kustomize overlays (`ns.kustomize("github.com/org/repo/path?ref=tag")`), and versioned github urls.
prBodyNotes: {{#if releaseTimestamp}}{{else}}⚠️ No release timestamp is available for this dependency, so `minimumReleaseAge` was **not enforced**. Review the upstream release before merging.{{/if}}

customManagers.description: container images in app.ts (`image: "repo:tag"`, or `h.helmImage("repo:tag")` for a chart's values) and the shared images
github release urls in app.ts sources
tag urls on raw.githubusercontent.com in app.ts sources
helm charts from a repository (ns.helm), written as the repository's url plus the chart's name
helm charts from an oci registry (ns.helm)
pinned tools in pins.json released from github with a 'v' prefix (hubble). kubectl and talosctl are deliberately not tracked: they follow the cluster version, which is upgraded by hand.

packageRules.description: PR NOTE: pins.json holds download hashes that renovate cannot compute.
prBodyNotes: ℹ️ Run `just pins refresh` on this branch to update the download hashes in `pins.json`.

packageRules.description: NAMING: oci helm charts are looked up as docker tags, which renovate would otherwise describe as '<chart> Docker tag'.
GROUPING: all workflow action updates arrive as one PR.
GROUPING: cilium's helm chart and its crds (fetched from the repository at the same tag) move together.
GROUPING: the snapshot controller and the snapshot crds come from the same release.
VERSIONS: the kubernetes-mixin tags its releases 'version-X.Y.Z'; the tag is kept whole when it is updated.
VERSIONS: dcgm-exporter tags its releases '<exporter>-<dcgm>' (4.6.0-4.8.3), which semver reads as a pre-release; only the first three numbers are the version.
VERSIONS: linuxserver appends a '-lsNNN' build suffix that changes on every rebuild.
VERSIONS: llama.cpp releases are monotonically increasing build numbers.
PR NOTE: envoy-gateway supports a specific range of gateway-api releases.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ `envoy-gateway` supports a specific gateway-api release range. Bump and check them together.

packageRules.description: VERSIONS: the @types/node major follows the node major from nixpkgs, so it only changes by hand. Minor and patch updates are fine.
